verdict.line: You lose if you let her stack Riposte charges and all-in post-6; you win if you poke her down with Shock Blast before she closes the gap.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a range-vs-range-denial puzzle: Fiora's W (Riposte) parries your next basic attack and reflects magic damage, so every empowered Cannon auto or point-blank Hammer poke you throw out carelessly gets eaten. The 47.6% head-to-head over 2154 games says this is genuinely even — the lane goes to whoever manages stance swaps and Riposte timing better, not to raw kit strength.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up and she's in range
theirWindow.what: She can parry and negate your next auto or Thundering Blow for free magic damage back. Don't throw E (Thundering Blow) or walk up for a poke auto while her W is clearly available — bait it out with a minion or your Shock Blast orb instead.

yourWindow.what: This is your window to full-combo: swap to Hammer, land Thundering Blow (E) for the knockback, then follow with autos or swap back to Cannon for Shock Blast poke. She has no answer to your damage while W is down.

start.why: 93.2% pick rate at 47.8% win — the extra sustain and auto damage help you trade autos into her Duelist healing without losing the exchange.

boots.why: Fiora leans on repeated auto-attacks (Q resets, E attack speed, passive stacking), so the flat physical damage reduction directly undercuts her stacking pattern. Picked in 47% of games at 48% win.

core.why: Builds mana sustain early so you can spam Shock Blast poke without running dry, setting up the 51.8% win-rate path.
Active haste lets you disengage or reset fights after baiting her Riposte, which is critical since you have no hard escape otherwise.
Converts your mana stockpile into the burst damage that punishes her when Riposte is down.
The highest-pick-rate fourth item in this build path (20.4% over 334 games); adds the burst-into-slow you need to finish poke combos.

situational.when: she is stacking her passive healing hard and resisting your poke damage
she builds armor to shrug off your physical poke

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the hit-and-run poke pattern this matchup demands — land Shock Blast or an auto, then use the burst of move speed to stay outside her Lunge (Q) and Burst of Speed (E) range before she can parry or close.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the highest win-rate combo here (50.2% over the Flash+Ignite option's 45.9%) and lets you reset mana at base after poke trades, then teleport back in to punish her when Riposte is down.

playing.title: Bait Riposte with minions, not yourself
playing.detail: Walk a minion auto into range or fire Shock Blast through a wave before committing your own Thundering Blow — if she parries the minion poke instead of your real damage, her W is wasted.

playing.title: Stance-swap to punish cooldowns
playing.detail: The instant you see her W go on cooldown (visible on her bar), swap to Hammer and land Thundering Blow into auto-resets; this is your highest-damage window all lane.

playing.title: Respect Blade Waltz from level 6 on
playing.detail: Her R dashes to deal physical damage with diminishing returns on repeat hits against the same target — don't overextend post-6 even when she looks low, since the all-in threat is real.

playing.title: Poke before she stacks Duelist
playing.detail: Her passive heals her per stack as she lands hits, so winning the trade early in an exchange matters more than winning it late — front-load your Shock Blast damage rather than trading autos back and forth.

playing.title: Use Acceleration Gate to extend Shock Blast
playing.detail: Firing E (Acceleration Gate) then Shock Blast through it increases the orb's speed, range, and damage — use this to poke her from further outside her Lunge range than she expects.

playing.title: Track her E for all-in windows
playing.detail: Burst of Speed gives her bonus attack speed and move speed on landed hits; if she pops it near you without a kill, she's committed to an all-in — this is when you knockback with Thundering Blow and disengage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the matchup reasoning, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical read on the live ability text.

stats.opponentTip: Protect your Vitals before reaching level 6 while applying pressure to gain lane control. Purchase Executioner’s Calling and be careful of having thundering Blow [E] blocked by Riposte (W).
